title: Golden Hour
description: Paint a sunset sky in three stops, bottom to top: orange (0.98, 0.45, 0.1), pale gold (0.95, 0.75, 0.35) and dusk blue (0.25, 0.3, 0.6). Gold sits exactly halfway up, and each blend is smooth.
hintText: Use two mix() calls. The first blends orange into gold over the lower half, and the second blends the result into blue over the upper half. smoothstep() makes the blend amounts.
